source.rule: A system type that is a subsystem within a composite may also be deployed as an independent operational individual. The internal child instance and separately deployed instance must not be conflated.

predeclared_native_acceptance: Guarded session-0 SSH import/export exactly preserves all populated authored tables, especially two Unit/Operations/SystemDeployment rows and the unchanged two-child SystemStructure. Preserve GUI PID13340, registry and source/raw hashes.

Observe installed converter diagnostics and classify any error or new warning explicitly; valid accepted simulation requires zero conversion errors/notes, nonempty SXO/event log/report and independently reviewed warnings.

If native accepts, trace one TEACH-AIR-01 top operational instance and one separately deployed TEACH-SUB-B operational instance to distinct units and mission assignments. Compare each unit's three scheduled mission starts and terminal readiness. Composite child-B embedded instance must not be counted as a third operational system.

Reconcile PM, mission, SystemResults and StockTotalResults bins and terminal state, and state any result aggregation limit when the report does not expose per-unit rows. Separate read-only reviewer must replay without author code.
limits: One parent top and one extra independent copy of child B at one base, both zero failure rate and one shared mission profile. Other subsystem types, failures, PM on the independent child, station separation, GUI visuals and cross-engine parity remain unverified.
